name: Starshower

command.name: Starfall
verbatim: Start of Combat: Mark 3 Enemies in any lane with Solar Flare.
Each Round: 50% chance to deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy with Solar Flare (Damage Rate: +100%). This consumes the Solar Flare mark on the target.
Rounds 1, 3, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +80%).
At 6+ Stars: Each Round: Increase the Tactical Damage dealt when consuming Solar Flare to +200%.
Rounds 6-10: If no Enemy has Solar Flare, mark 3 Enemies in any lane with Solar Flare. This effect can only trigger once per combat.

At 10 Stars: When you consume a Solar Flare mark: Reduce the Damage Received by -6% of 2 Allies within adjacency for 1 round(s). If you have Resistance, increase this effect by 1.5x (-9%). If you have Advantage, this effect instead applies to 3 Allies in any lane.

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Night Guardian
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to Cleanse 1 Negative effect from 2 other Allies in any lane and grant them Evade (Rate: 10%) for 1 round(s). Evade causes each instance of damage against the target to have a chance to be ignored.

habits.name: Battle Subversion
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce the Intelligence and Initiative (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Enemies in any lane by -10.5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Ill Portents
verbatim: Starfall gains: Each Round: Increase the Tactical Damage dealt when consuming Solar Flare to +200%.
Rounds 6-10: If no Enemy has Solar Flare, mark 3 Enemies in any lane with Solar Flare. This effect can only trigger once per combat.

habits.name: Tactical Breach
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Tactical Damage Received by +17% of 1 Enemy in the same lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Wishkeeper's Grace
habits.verbatim: Starfall gains: When you consume a Solar Flare mark: Reduce the Damage Received by -6% of 2 Allies within adjacency for 1 round(s). If you have Resistance, increase this effect by 1.5x (-9%). If you have Advantage, this effect instead applies to 3 Allies in any lane.

formation_needs: Advantage expands Wishkeeper's Grace to all three Allies
Tactical Left Flank benefits from Sentinel's Wit
notes: Solar Flare is a consumable mark rather than a documented independent damage-over-time effect.
Night Guardian is chance-based even at Habit Level 5, so Cleanse and Evade are support coverage rather than guaranteed round-by-round protection.
At 6 Stars and Ill Portents Level 5, the Solar Flare-consuming Tactical hit reaches a 200% damage rate and can refresh all marks once during rounds 6-10 if none remain.

review: Tactical Breach's full sentence says it increases Tactical Damage Received, while the five-column upgrade row is labeled Damage Dealt. The values are normalized to Tactical Damage Received because that is the explicit target effect in both the screenshot sentence and installed-client description; preserve this UI-label conflict when citing the upgrade track.
